doc.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth as William Huddleston and moves to Detroit
summary: Lateef gives his birth name, birthplace Chattanooga, moves to Lorain and Detroit, and the family name change to Evans.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, my full name now is Yusef Abdul Lateef; however, I was born uh my name was William Emanuel Huddleston. I was born October 9, 1920 in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
Okay, and uh how long did you uh, did you reside there?
Until I was about three years old, and my parents moved to Lorain, Ohio, and uh at age five they moved to Detroit, Michigan, and that’s where I began kindergarten.
And uh what were your parents’ names?
Uh...it seems that my father changed our last name again to Evans. So I finished uh grade school and high school as William Evans.
